concerns.text: FR-001 lists the required output columns but does not mention that the `predicted_correctness` column (required by `contracts/annotated_questions.schema.yaml`) will be produced. Without an explicit statement that predictions are generated at this stage, the presence of this column is untestable.

SC-006 (and similarly SC-003) require regression analyses that include covariates for question difficulty, video length, and answer type, yet the specification provides no source, format, or method for obtaining these covariates. The lack of a defined data source makes the success criteria unverifiable.
